ADBE.headline: Unconfirmed reports of a DOL green-card (PERM) suspension
ADBE.why: Only Cloudera's suspension is confirmed; a tracker shows Adobe's PERM cases on hold. A hiring and regulatory issue, not a moat breach.

BKNG.headline: FTC reportedly preparing action over Priceline-affiliate hotel ads ($500M+ at stake)
BKNG.why: A fine of that size is small against FCF, but a fee case touches the business model. Check that the moat doesn't rest on misleading ads (METHOD 3) and that no debt is needed (event check 5). Unconfirmed by the FTC.

LULU.headline: New CEO overhauls the C-suite: Athleta's CEO becomes President and Chief Product Officer
LULU.why: Fixing product missteps and recalls: an event if one-time and solvable in 1-3 years (event checks 3-4). A new team must be judged on capital allocation and candour (METHOD 4).

NVMI.headline: Fell 10% in the semiconductor sell-off; no company news
NVMI.why: A market-wide move: price, not value (METHOD 7). The screen's buy-range label came from a share-count scale error (fixed); NVMI is above Sticker.

QFIN.headline: Down 9% over 5 days with US-listed Chinese ADRs
QFIN.why: A market-wide move. Country and VIE risk is a standing checklist item for China ADRs (METHOD 2), not news.

SMCI.headline: New director or officer change (8-K item 5.02)
SMCI.why: Given its accounting history, read the 8-K for finance or audit roles (METHOD 4: cash must be real, candour).

SMID.headline: 13D/A amendment filed
SMID.why: A large holder changed its position. Read the amendment for who and how much (METHOD 1: Radar).

TBBK.headline: 8-K/A amends a director or officer change
TBBK.why: Read who changed and why; banks magnify management risk (METHOD 4).
